title: After Africa: 'thank God for slavery'
summary: The strongest survived hard times. After visiting Africa he said he was glad to be born in America, the best place in the world despite its faults.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Well, you had to be strong to survive. But the thing is, you know --
I tell the guys, though, you know, when I went to Africa -- after I came back from Africa, I said, thank God for slavery.

I said, if it hadn't been for slavery, I'd still probably -- I would be in Africa, you know, but if I had been born, because -- Africa's nice, a pretty country, but -- in fact, I've been all over the world, and there's no place like this country, you know. Even as bad as it is, it's the best place in the world to be.
